news.headline: Alcaraz downs Munar in 3-set thriller to advance at Queen's Club

news.headline: Tennis at Madrid Open suspended due to major power outage
news.linkText: Power outage shuts down play at Madrid Open
news.description: A major power outage reported in Spain and Portugal shut down matches at the Madrid Open. Two singles matches and one doubles match were underway when the power went out. The event is scheduled to resume on Tuesday.
